purpose: AI1 assisted-2: a fresh held-out split (heldout-3) and a development split (assist-dev), specified before any case, prompt, verifier or configuration of assisted-2 exists.
ground_truth: derived from the generation parameters under the frozen service_agreement.v1 contract; no extractor writes expected outputs

entity_cases: defined short name after the full name
full name only in the signature block
two entities sharing a prefix, one not a party

assist-dev.use: development only; never part of a final measurement

protocol.freeze: heldout-3 cases, expected outputs and hashes are frozen in heldout-3-preregistration.json before assisted-2 exists; never read for development afterwards
protocol.rules_baseline: rules-1 measured on heldout-3 after the freeze, in the same PR (heldout-3-baseline.json)
protocol.assisted_2_freeze: prompt, model, configuration and verifier version hashed in a committed file before the first heldout-3 call
protocol.measured_once: a later change cannot be measured on heldout-3 again

decision_rule: assisted-2 may be enabled only if every hard gate holds on every run, every primary threshold holds on the worst of the three runs, and the budget holds; otherwise it is reported as measured and this milestone ships rules-only (no assisted-3).
